Q-21.question: Playhead: the Design draws a playhead on the strip (a line, a time bubble and a ◀▶ knob) but no note says how far it may be dragged (only inside the selection, or the whole video) or whether play starts from it. Assumption: dragging it scrubs the Preview inside the selection and changes neither the selection nor the price. R-192, R-193 (TC-215).
Q-21.answer: play should start from where the playhead is and it can be dragged between the two white <> icons
